title: Finite coherent cohomology on the projective line
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and let $\mathcal F$ be a
coherent module on $\mathbf P^1_k$.
Then $H^0(\mathbf P^1_k,\mathcal F)$ and $H^1(\mathbf P^1_k,\mathcal F)$
are finite-dimensional over $k$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-projective-space-coherent-finiteness] with the Noetherian ring $A=k$ and $n=1$. The scheme $\mathbf P^1_k=\operatorname{Proj}k[x_0,x_1]$ of [def-sc-p1-standard] is the same scheme $P=\operatorname{Proj}(A[x_0,x_1])$ as in [def-pc-projective-space-twist], and $\mathcal F$ is coherent on it [pqf-def-coherent]. Hence each $H^q(\mathbf P^1_k,\mathcal F)$ is a finite $k$-module; a finite module over the field $k$ is a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space, which gives the assertions for $q=0$ and $q=1$.
